description: Get full detail for one grocery product by its product_id — price, promo price, stock level, size, categories, aisle location, images. Pass zip_code or location_id for store-specific price/stock. Example: kroger_product_details({ product_id: "0001111041700", zip_code: "45202" })

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own Kroger API credentials as "client_id:client_secret"

zip_code.description: US ZIP code — nearest store auto-selected for price/stock

name: kroger_product_details
title: Kroger Product Details
